title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 31
description: Ten questions on Numbers 31: the war against Midian, the purification afterward and the dividing of the plunder.

questions.text: After avenging Israel on the Midianites, what would happen to Moses, according to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Moses to avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites, and said that afterward he would be gathered to his people.

answers.text: He would enter the land of Canaan
He would be made king over Israel
He would go up to Mount Sinai again
He would be gathered to his people

questions.text: How many men were sent from every tribe to the war against Midian?
questions.explanation: Moses told them to send one thousand out of every tribe, and so twelve thousand were armed for war.

questions.text: Who went with the army, holding the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm?
questions.explanation: Moses sent them to the war with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets in his hand.

questions.text: Besides the five kings of Midian, who was killed with the sword?
questions.explanation: They killed the five kings of Midian and also Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.

answers.text: Sihon the king of the Amorites

questions.text: Why did Moses say the women should not have been kept alive?
questions.explanation: Moses said these women had caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Yahweh in the matter of Peor.

answers.text: They had hidden the kings of Midian
They had stolen from the sanctuary
They had attacked the camp at night
Through Balaam's counsel they led Israel to sin at Peor

questions.text: On which days were those who had killed or touched the slain to purify themselves?
questions.explanation: They were to stay outside the camp seven days and purify themselves on the third day and on the seventh day.

answers.text: The first day and the eighth day
The third day and the seventh day
The second day and the fourth day
The seventh day and the fourteenth day

questions.text: What was to be done with gold, silver and other things that could withstand the fire?
questions.explanation: Everything that may withstand the fire was to go through the fire to be clean, and also be purified with the water for impurity.

answers.text: They had to be thrown into the Jordan
They had to go through the fire
They had to be left outside the camp

questions.text: What tribute to Yahweh was taken from the half of the men of war?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told them to levy a tribute of the men of war: one soul of five hundred, of persons, cattle, donkeys and flocks.

questions.text: What did the officers report to Moses after counting their men?
questions.explanation: They said they had taken the sum of the men of war under their command, and not one man of them was lacking.

questions.text: Where did Moses and Eleazar bring the gold of the captains?
questions.explanation: They brought the gold of the captains into the Tent of Meeting for a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh.
